title: 친구에게, 윗사람에게: 민준아? 왜요?
objective: By the end, you can call a friend by name with 아 or 야. You can also add 요 to short answers and phrases when you speak to seniors, coworkers, or strangers.
summary: Learn when to call a friend with 아/야 and when to add 요 to short answers so you sound polite.

task.title: Call, answer, and rewrite
task.line: Use 아/야 when you call friends and younger people, and add 요 when you need to be polite.

forms.form: Name ending in a consonant + 아
forms.when: Use it to call a friend, a younger person, or a child.
forms.means: Hey, (name)! It is a friendly call.

forms.form: Name ending in a vowel + 야
forms.when: Use it in the same situations, but when the name ends in a vowel.
forms.means: Hey, (name)! It is a friendly call.

forms.when: Use it for a short answer or question to a stranger, a senior, a coworker, or staff.
forms.means: It makes a short reply polite.
forms.example: A: 뭐 드릴까요? B: 아이스 아메리카노요.
forms.exampleMeaning: A: What can I get you? B: An iced Americano, please.

forms.when: Use it when you stop in the middle of a sentence while you talk politely.
forms.means: It makes a half sentence polite.
forms.example: A: 이거 드실래요? B: 저는 방금 먹었는데요.
forms.exampleMeaning: A: Would you like some of this? B: Well, I just ate.

watchOut: 선생님아 (X) → 선생님 (O): Do not use 아/야 after a respectful title like 선생님, 사장님, or 부장님, or with a senior's name. Just say the title.
지수아 (X) → 지수야 (O): A name that ends in a vowel takes 야. A name that ends in a consonant takes 아.
왜? (X) → 왜요? (O): To a boss or a stranger, a short word without 요 sounds rude.
아니 (X) → 아니요 (O): To a stranger, say 아니요 and 네. Use 아니 and 응 only with close friends, family, and younger people.
exercises: Add 아 or 야 to call your friend: ① 현우__, 내일 시간 있어? ② 지민__, 이 책 다 읽었어? ③ 다은__, 빨리 와!
Is this OK to say? Answer Yes or No: ① To your teacher: 선생님아, 질문 있어요. ② To your younger sister: 유나야, 밥 먹었어? ③ To a cafe worker: 따뜻한 거요. ④ To your boss: 왜?
Your manager asks you a question. Add 요 to make the answer polite: ① A: 몇 개 필요해요? B: 두 개 ② A: 회의는 언제예요? B: 다음 주 ③ A: 왜 일찍 가요? B: 병원에 가야 돼서
Rewrite these sentences for a close friend. Use 아/야 and drop 씨 and 요: ① 소희 씨, 어디 가요? ② 민석 씨, 점심 먹었어요?
Answer in Korean with one word. ① A friend asks: 이 영화 봤어? (You say no. Choose 아니 or 응.) ② A stranger asks: 여기 앉아도 돼요? (You say yes. Choose 네 or 아니요.)
answers: ① 현우야 ② 지민아 ③ 다은아
① No (say 선생님, not 선생님아) ② Yes ③ Yes ④ No (say 왜요?)
① 두 개요. ② 다음 주요. ③ 병원에 가야 돼서요.
